title: robo-greeno/data-a/pose_stamped
description: Canonical time-stamped robot-state message published by Data A (locomotion). Consumed by Data B (spatial tagging of detections) and Cloud (collaborative mapping). Conventions chosen to match the AgCloud canonical: epoch milliseconds, body frame +X forward / +Y left / +Z up, SI units, quaternion (w,x,y,z).

robot_id.description: Stable per-robot id, e.g. 'spider-01'. Same id used across all teams and MQTT topics.

stamp_ms.description: Capture time, epoch MILLISECONDS, UTC. Matches AgCloud captured_ts. NOT float seconds.

seq.description: Monotonic sequence counter per robot, for ordering and loss detection.

frame.description: Body frame: +X forward, +Y left, +Z up (right-handed, REP-103 style).

odom_frame.description: Reference frame the pose is expressed in. 'odom' = drifting odometry relative to power-on pose (indoor greenhouse, no GPS). Cloud fuses these into the shared map.

position_m.description: [x, y, z] in metres, in odom_frame.

orientation_quat.description: [w, x, y, z] unit quaternion, body->odom rotation.

covariance6.description: Optional diagonal pose covariance [x,y,z,roll,pitch,yaw]; omit if unknown.

imu.description: Raw/filtered IMU in body frame, for Data B time-sync and Cloud dead-reckoning.

foot_contacts.description: Per-leg ground contact, leg order front_left, mid_left, back_left, back_right, mid_right, front_right (same order as servo channels / URDF).

stability.description: Static-stability summary at capture, for Data B's IQA: weight or skip frames grabbed mid-step. Derived by Data A from foot_contacts + body angular rate, so Data B need not know gait internals. Rides in pose_stamped, so the option-(c) freshest-pose reply carries it (no separate request needed).

stable.description: True when the body is in a stable support state at this instant (>=3 feet planted, low body angular rate, CoM inside the support polygon) -- a good moment to trust the frame.

support_feet.description: Number of feet in ground contact at this instant.

margin_deg.description: Static tip-over margin in degrees: the angle the body could tilt about the nearest support-polygon edge before the CoM projection leaves it. Larger = more stable; ~0 = on the verge; 0 when fewer than 3 feet are down.

joint_angles_rad.description: Optional: 18 joint angles, channel order leg*3+{coxa,femur,tibia}. See servo_conventions.md.

node_id.description: Optional: nearest greenhouse-graph node id, for Cloud's node-based position model (e.g. 'n12').
